attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76418 - Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
attack_surface.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-41709 - Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-48356 - Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-111497 - Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-109618 - PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-110447 - Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-106931 - EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96656 - Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96655 - Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96654 - Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96652 - Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654,…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-110936 - Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102764 - BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

attack_surface.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-105134 - Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76519 - Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

attack_surface.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-0322 - Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

attack_surface.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96951 - Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-5477 - ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

attack_surface.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.
